notes: FP8 packaging of reference-tiny-llm for GPU vLLM. gpu_memory_mib is a DECLARED scheduler envelope from ~2x weight compression vs FP16 for this small model plus KV headroom — NOT a measured VRAM footprint and NOT a throughput/quality claim (ADR-002, ADR-007). Launch: vllm serve <fp8-capable-checkpoint> --quantization fp8 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.85 (exact dtype flags depend on GPU arch / vLLM version — verify against your install). Requires hardware and checkpoint support for FP8; do not invent tokens/s in CI.
